entry.title: USPS to debut weekly fuel fee in 2027, matching FedEx, UPS practices
entry.summary: The surcharge for package shipping services will be tied to diesel and jet fuel prices, which have been climbing this year.

entry.title: USTR weighs extending pause on China-linked vessel fees to January
entry.summary: The suspension is currently set to lift Nov. 9, but the agency said more time would allow the U.S. and China to further negotiations.

entry.title: Supply Chain AI Has an Execution Problem
entry.summary: AI is everywhere in supply chain software now—but does it actually improve decisions? Here's why language models need a decision engine underneath, and the test every planner should run before trusting an AI recommendation.

entry.title: Audi investing $4B to build its first US plant in Georgia
entry.summary: The factory will have a production capacity of up to 200,000 vehicles a year, with construction slated to begin in 2027 and the first vehicles built in the early 2030s.

entry.title: Cycling apparel company unites planning, sourcing on single platform
entry.summary: MAAP joins Walmart, Pacsun and others who have teamed with technology vendor Bamboo Rose to enhance supply chain operations.

entry.title: UPS gears up for peak season with less Amazon volume in tow
entry.summary: The carrier expects U.S. volume to dip year over year in Q4, but packages from other customer segments are projected to boost revenue.

entry.title: Kroger taps RFID, computer vision data to boost inventory management
entry.summary: The grocery chain is providing machine learning insights to suppliers to improve availability while piloting radio frequency identification at 1,500 store bakeries.

entry.title: WD-40 credits supply chain for $7M in cost savings
entry.summary: The company cut costs in FY2026 through several operational improvements, such as reducing inventory levels, President and CEO Steven Brass said.

entry.title: Nvidia forges supplier agreements to expand capacity for AI
entry.summary: The artificial intelligence chipmaker signed deals with six suppliers to scale production of certain components by as much as 15-fold.

entry.title: Tesla begins humanoid production in California
entry.summary: Early customers for Optimus robots would use them for industrial applications, such as dangerous, repetitive tasks, CEO Elon Musk said.
